lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Prepare wet nursery beds with light standing water (2-3 cm).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5-10g/kg seed or salt water floatation (10% brine).
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for discolored or chaffy seeds.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure certified seed tag with >80% germination rate.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Puddle field with 5-7 cm standing water to reduce percolation losses.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Basal application of full P2O5, full K2O, and 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea) into puddled soil.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect for snail damage and root-knot nematode history.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Level field perfectly to maintain uniform water depth.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Maintain 2-3 cm shallow water layer at transplanting.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Zinc Sulphate 21% @ 25 kg/ha applied basal if soil test indicates deficiency.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for nursery thrips and caseworm.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20x15 cm spacing. Do not plant deeper than 2-3 cm.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No top-dressing during initial root establishment.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for whorl maggot and early armyworm clips.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure drainage channels are clear to prevent submergence during heavy monsoon downpours.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) or maintain 3-5 cm water.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 1st top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea) at active tillering.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Yellow Stem Borer (dead hearts), leaf folder, and bacterial leaf blight.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid excessive nitrogen which promotes sheath blight and blast.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Maintain continuous 5 cm standing water; critical stage for spikelet fertility.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: 2nd top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea) at panicle initiation.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for neck blast lesions and Brown Planthopper (BPH) at base of tillers.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Never let soil dry out during panicle initiation.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 7. फूल आना एवं दाना भराव (दूधिया अवस्था)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Keep field saturated with 2-3 cm water.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Optional foliar spray of 0:0:50 (SOP) @ 1% to enhance grain filling.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Gundhi bug (milky grain sucking) and false smut balls.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid chemical spraying during peak anthesis (9 AM - 12 PM).

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Completely drain out field water 10-14 days before harvest.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for rat burrows in bunds.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Allow soil to firm up for manual or mechanical combine movement.
Harvest when 80-85% grains in panicle turn straw golden.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 10. कटाई उपरांत प्रबंधन एवं सुरक्षित भंडारण
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for rice moth and grain weevils.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sun dry paddy down to 12-14% moisture before storage or milling.
